add_switch.title: Add Nexa self-learning switch or dimmer
add_switch.description: To pair a new receiver: keep the random house code, save, put the receiver in learn mode and turn the new switch or dimmer on. To control a receiver that already listens to a remote, enter that remote's house code and unit (press the remote and look for a tellstick_local_command event), or use "Add switch or dimmer by pressing a remote".

data_description.name: Leave empty to name it after its house code and unit.
data_description.type: Dimmer: for self-learning dimmer receivers. Brightness is sent in 16 steps.

data_description.new_sensors_enabled: 433 MHz sensors from neighbours are picked up too. When off, new sensors are added disabled and you enable the ones you want.

replace_sensor.title: Replace sensor
replace_sensor.description: Many 433 MHz sensors pick a new random ID after a battery change or reset, so they show up as a new sensor. Pick the old sensor and the new one: the old sensor's entities, name and history are kept and will follow the new ID, and the new duplicate is removed.

data_description.old_sensor: Sensors that have been silent longest are listed first.
data_description.new_sensor: Most recently discovered sensors are listed first. Compare the readings to find the right one.

learn_timeout.title: No remote heard
learn_timeout.description: No self-learning remote or wall switch (Nexa/Proove/Arctech) was heard. Make sure it's within range of the TellStick and press an on or off button (not 'all on/off').

learn_confirm.title: Remote found
learn_confirm.description: Heard house code {house}, unit {unit}. The new switch or dimmer sends exactly this code, so receivers that obey this button will also obey Home Assistant - no pairing needed. Pressing the button later also updates its on/off state in Home Assistant.

data_description.type: Choose dimmer if the receiver this button controls is a dimmer.

error.already_exists: A switch or dimmer with this house code and unit already exists.

progress.press_remote: Press an on or off button on the remote or wall switch you want to copy. Listening for {seconds} seconds...

abort.already_exists: A switch or dimmer with house code {house}, unit {unit} already exists.

old_firmware.title: {name} needs firmware {latest}
old_firmware.description:
{name} reports firmware {firmware}. The local interface this integration uses was added in TellStick Net firmware {latest}; older versions don't have it, so sensors and switches won't work until the device is updated.

Telldus' firmware is installed over TFTP: download `tellstick_net_fw{latest}.hex` from Telldus and follow their guide (Learn more), or see "Updating the firmware" in this integration's README. If an update is interrupted the device goes into recovery mode (LED blinks in groups of seven) and the upload can simply be repeated.

This notice disappears once the device reports firmware {latest} or newer.
